name: Olula del Río (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Olula del Río (a mountain on green above waves, in an ornate frame).
history: Olula del Río was authorised to adopt municipal arms by the BOE of 6 June 1973 but did not register them until 2004; the flag in use, a rectangular white flag with the municipal arms at the centre, has no official character as it is not registered.

features.role: Olula del Río arms — mountain above waves
